| description = Rare spawn that drops one of the medallion pieces for the Veeshan's Peak Key quest.  Similar to camping the Rotting Skeleton in Dreadlands, in that it has a 1% spawn chance and a 6:40 respawn timer.  PH is [[spectral keeper]] or (rarely) [[spectral partisan]] or [[spectral champion]].

This mob and its placeholder spawn just inside the doorway and don't roam. You can safely hide inside the room nearby to the southeast while waiting for the respawn. A fairly stress-free camp, all things considered.

*This is no longer a /list camp on the Green or Blue servers.
